ns2:course.label: Making Sustainable Design
ns2:course.description: Introduction to techniques and tools for representing and realizing sustainable design ideas. Using a case study method, students are introduced to digital and analog means of representing concepts, data, and spatial forms. Through hands-on assignments, tutorials, and workshops, students learn basic skills to express ideas graphically and in three dimensions. Prerequisite: ARCH 171 and ARTD 225. Limited to majors.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: ARCH 171 and ARTD 225. Limited to majors.
